Aridanin further targets Neuropilin-2, indicating a possible pathway through which Lophodienone may influence Neuropilin-2. The scores from the two paths, while not perfectly aligned, both point to a consistent target hierarchy involving Aridanin as a central mediator. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Lophodienone and Neuropilin-2, though the strength of the relationship is partially reflected in the varying scores. The presence of a shared target (Aridanin) and the sequential targeting suggest a plausible biological pathway, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Lophodienone and Neuropilin-2.
